newsitem.title: DUBAI: UAE's Etisalat announces flat div, bonus issue.
newsitem.headline: UAE's Etisalat announces flat div, bonus issue.

text.p: The United Arab Emirates telecommunications firm Etisalat said it would distribute a 25 dirham cash dividend for the second half of 1996 and announced a one-for-four bonus share issue.
In the first half of 1996 Etisalat paid a 25 dirham dividend -- the same as that paid in the last six months of 1995.
Etisalat shares, which dominate the UAE unofficial stock market, would be suspended from January 23 to February 3, during which time the dividends would be paid, the company said.
On Monday the shares were trading at 960 dirhams.
Brokers said Etisalat would transfer 446.9 million dirhams from reserves, increasing its paid-up capital to 2.3345 billion dirhams. The authorised share capital is three billion dirhams.
The UAE government owns 60 percent of Etisalat shares, with private investors holding the balance.
